summary: Hudson Technologies filed an 8-K (Item 8.01 Other Events) disclosing that its primary refrigerant reclamation facility in Champaign, Illinois was damaged by storms and tornadoes on June 11, 2026. No injuries were reported. The company has activated emergency protocols, secured the site, and begun the insurance claim process. Operations will be diverted to its Smyrna, Georgia facility. No transaction, change of control, or special situation event is involved; this is a routine operational disclosure of a weather-related incident.
